FEATURE_HEADLINE: A money coach that knows your numbers
FEATURE_SUBHEAD: Ask about your spending, get plan suggestions, and explore what-ifs — powered by your own AI key, on your own data.
PROBLEM_HEADLINE: Generic money advice doesn't know your situation
PROBLEM_BODY:
Articles and calculators give one-size-fits-all answers. They don't know your income, your envelopes or your goals — so the advice stays abstract.

FincWin's AI Coach reasons over your actual numbers. You bring your own OpenAI or Anthropic key, and your data is used to answer your questions — not to train anyone's model.
HOW_IT_WORKS:
• Add your API key — OpenAI or Anthropic; it stays on your device.
  • Ask a question — “Where can I cut $200?” or “Can I afford this?”
  • Get grounded answers — the coach reasons over your real budget and goals.
  • Act on suggestions — apply ideas directly to your envelopes and goals.
CAPABILITIES:
• ✓Bring your own key — OpenAI or Anthropic.
  • ✓Grounded in your data — answers reflect your actual numbers.
  • ✓Spending Q&A in plain language.
  • ✓Plan suggestions for budgets, debt and savings.
  • ✓Private by design — your key and data stay yours.
  • ✓No markup — you pay your provider directly.
